transcript.t: What will life be like in 2050? Let me share my predictions.
First, many people will work from home, because video meetings will be very clear.
Second, most cars will be electric, and some will drive themselves.
Third, robots will help in hospitals, but doctors will still take care of patients.
Fourth, students will use smart screens to learn, and teachers will help each student with different tasks.
Of course, nobody knows for sure. But I believe the future will be exciting.
